title: Percentage of a signed amount, rounded down
description: amount is a number of cents and may be negative (a debt). Return amount * pct / 100 rounded down toward negative infinity, so a debt is rounded to the larger debt: 5% of -150 is -7.5 and gives -8, while 5% of 150 is 7.5 and gives 7. pct is between 0 and 100.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states floor semantics (round toward negative infinity) in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
